name: What is the best type of paint for interior trim?

mainEntity.name: What is the best type of paint for interior trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: For interior trim, durable paints with a satin, semi-gloss, or high-gloss finish are generally recommended. These finishes are more resistant to scuffs and easier to clean than matte or eggshell paints, which is important for high-traffic areas like baseboards and doorframes. Options include acrylic-latex enamel for good durability and easy cleanup, or alkyd (oil-based) paints for a harder, more traditional finish, though they take longer to dry and clean up with mineral spirits. We can help you choose based on your specific trim material and desired aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable paints with a satin, semi-gloss, or high-gloss finish are best for interior trim, offering resistance to scuffs and easy cleaning.
